_instructions: One entry per term; the page sorts them alphabetically. Fill in 'definition'. 'thresholds' is optional (how cutoffs or thresholds were chosen); leave it empty to hide it. A term with an empty definition shows 'Coming soon.' Add or remove terms freely.

terms.definition: Team strength in points against relative to average D1 team
Opponent and pace-adjusted points gained/allowed per 12 possessions.
Probability of winning given both teams’ game stats, independent of the score.
Expected points added by a play based on change in down, field position, and game time.
the share of plays gaining set fractions of yards remaining for a first down: 50% of the distance on 1st down, 70% on 2nd, converting on 3rd or 4th.
Run of 10+ yards or pass of 16+ yards – the top ~15% of each play type.
Rush yards credited to the offensive line. Negative yards count at 120%, the first 4 yards of a run at 100%, yards 5–10 at 50%.
Share of runs stopped for no gain or a loss.
Share of plays ending in a sack, tackle for loss, pass breakup, interception or fumble.
Drive with a first down at or inside the opponent’s 40 yard line.
Share of drives that are quality drives or end in a touchdown by the offense.
Average points scored from goal-to-go situations.

EPA lost to penalties, determined by resulting change in field positions. Note: this does not account for plays “called back” due to fouls during the play (e.g., holds, illegal blocks), as play by play data are insufficient to determine whether the foul contributed to the yards gained.
Punt/return yards compared with what is typical from the spot of the punt.
